name: The Title Cocoon
shortDescription: A new seven-storey condominium on Soi Cherngtalay 3 in Choeng Thale, part of the Rhom Bho Property "The Title" collection, with one-bedroom apartments open to foreign buyers.
description:
The Title Cocoon is an upcoming condominium on Soi Cherngtalay 3 in Choeng Thale, on Phuket's northwest side, from Rhom Bho Property, the developer behind the The Title brand. The official project site shows a seven-storey building and one-bedroom apartments on floors 1 to 7, sold within the foreign quota.

The project site names Bang Tao Beach, Surin Beach, Boat Avenue, Porto de Phuket and Laguna Phuket as nearby, without distances. It advertises 0% instalments for the whole construction period; prices, unit sizes, ownership type, facilities and the completion date had not been published when we checked.

Message us on WhatsApp for the current price list, unit sizes and handover date.
